title: data for billing.invoice_paid
description: Payment of an invoice was confirmed (re-read from the payment provider, paid with the preserved balance or registered by Meshio). Envelope business_id and channel_id are null.

kind.description: subscription = monthly fee of the cycle; seat_addition = prorated seats added mid-cycle; overage = messages above the allowance (only with a published price and the integrator's authorization).

total_micros.description: Invoice total. Integer string in micros (R$ 1 = "1000000").

paid_via.description: wallet = preserved paid balance (opt-in); manual = registered by Meshio.
